product_family: AI headshot and portrait generation (consumer + teams), AI photo editing tools

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type II compliant ... Unlike Type I (which evaluates controls at a single point in time), Type II involves a months-long audit. (Audited by Prescient Security via Vanta per Aragon's compliance blog: 'our partners at Vanta and Prescient Security for helping us achieve this milestone.')

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No ISO 27001 certification is claimed anywhere on the security policy or trust pages; only SOC 2 Type II is listed.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No HIPAA compliance is claimed; the service is a consumer/business headshot generator and does not advertise handling of PHI.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Aragon honors GDPR data-subject rights ('You may request access to, rectification of, or erasure of your Personal Data ... request restriction of processing, object to processing, and request data portability.') but does not claim a formal GDPR certification (GDPR has no certification body); they reference a DPA and subprocessor list.

privacy.ai_training_note: Aragon contractually prohibits its AI providers from training on customer face data: 'We contractually prohibit our AI service providers from using face data to train generalized AI models or create pooled face training datasets.' Face data is deleted/anonymized within 30 days after content delivery (or end of subscription for active subscribers). AI inference/training is performed by subprocessors Astria, FAL.ai, and Replicate, all listed as 'AI inference and training' but contractually restricted from generalized training on customer data.
privacy.data_region: United States (AWS us-east-1); Heroku runs on AWS us-east-1

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS 1.2 or higher; all API and application endpoints TLS/SSL only

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Yes - 'Periodic penetration testing is conducted by independent security professionals.'

security.name: Bug bounty program
security.value: None found (no HackerOne/Bugcrowd program disclosed). Note: customers are contractually prohibited from running unauthorized pen tests/security assessments.

security.name: Vulnerability management
security.value: Continuous automated vulnerability scanning across production; findings triaged and remediated by severity

security.name: Access control
security.value: Least-privilege RBAC, MFA enforced on GitHub/AWS/Heroku/Vercel, session timeouts, strong password policy

security.name: Incident response
security.value: Formal incident response plan; Sentry monitoring; written post-mortems; written breach notification to affected customers

security.name: Hosting / infrastructure
security.value: AWS, Heroku, Vercel; multi-tenant datastores with logical separation; automated backups + tested DR

security.name: Payment security
security.value: No card data stored; processing via Stripe, Paddle, RevenueCat

products.name: AI Headshots (Individuals)
products.data_scope: User uploads 5+ selfies; face data processed by AI subprocessors (Astria/FAL.ai/Replicate) and deleted/anonymized within 30 days of delivery (or end of subscription)
products.notes: Core consumer product. Photos marketed as private; no generalized model training on face data.

products.name: Headshots for Teams
products.data_scope: Business customer manages End User access; same encryption + retention controls; governed by Customer Service Agreement and DPA
products.notes: Team/business tier with admin-managed accounts; this is the scope the Security Policy and DPA primarily address ('business customers and their end users').

products.name: AI Photo Generators & AI Editor tools
products.data_scope: Various tools (clothing changer, background changer, image generator, magic eraser, etc.) operating on uploaded user images under the same privacy/retention policy
products.notes: Large suite of supplementary photo tools; same data handling posture as core product.

compare.pricing_model: Paid subscription / one-time photo packs (consumer + team tiers); free entry-point tools

flags: Highly sensitive data type: biometric face/selfie data. Subject to biometric privacy laws (e.g. Illinois BIPA, Texas CUBI) - directory should note biometric sensitivity.

AI inference subprocessors (Astria, FAL.ai, Replicate) are labeled 'AI inference and training', but Aragon contractually prohibits generalized training on customer face data - distinction worth surfacing.
No bug bounty program; customers are contractually barred from independent pen testing.
US-only data residency (us-east-1); no EU data region option for EU customers despite GDPR rights being honored.
